briefdescription.para: Groups an existing data file by a cluster key produced by a function.

detaileddescription.para: The cluster key determines which data file will be associated with a particular manifest. All data files with the same cluster key will be written to the same manifest unless the file is large and split into multiple files. Manifests deleted via DeleteManifest or added via AddManifest are ignored during the rewrite process.

briefdescription.para: Determines which existing manifest files for the table should be rewritten.

detaileddescription.para: Manifests that do not match the predicate are kept as-is. If this is not called and no predicate is set, all manifests are rewritten.

briefdescription.para: Deletes a manifest file from the table.
Adds a manifest file to the table.

detaileddescription.para: The added manifest cannot contain new or deleted files.
By default, the manifest is rewritten to ensure all entries have explicit snapshot IDs. In that case, the caller manages the original manifest and this update manages the copy.

If manifest entries are allowed to inherit the snapshot ID assigned on commit, the original manifest becomes part of the table metadata when the commit succeeds and must not be deleted manually. If the manifest gets merged while preparing a new snapshot, it is deleted automatically when this operation succeeds. If the commit fails, the original manifest is retained and may be deleted or reused by the caller.

briefdescription.para: Get the summary map for this operation.
Clean up any uncommitted manifests that were created.

detaileddescription.para: Manifests may not be committed if Apply is called multiple times because a commit conflict has occurred. Implementations may keep around manifests because the same changes will be made by both Apply calls. This method instructs the implementation to clean up those manifests and passes the paths of the manifests that were actually committed.

parameterdescription.para: A set of manifest paths that were actually committed

briefdescription.para: API for rewriting manifests for a table.

detaileddescription.para: This API accumulates manifest files, produces a new snapshot of the table described only by the manifest files that were added, and commits that snapshot as the current.

This API can be used to rewrite matching manifests according to a clustering function as well as to replace specific manifests. Manifests that are deleted or added directly are ignored during the rewrite process. The set of active files in replaced manifests must be the same as in new manifests.
When committing, these changes will be applied to the latest table snapshot. Commit conflicts will be resolved by applying the changes to the new latest snapshot and reattempting the commit.
